name: Seaview Lodge

tagline.en: Friendly, good-value beds by the sea in Indreabhán: handy for the Aran Islands ferry, and the beach for a swim.
tagline.ga: Leapacha cairdiúla ar luach maith cois farraige in Indreabhán: áisiúil do bhád Árann, agus an trá le haghaidh snámh.

en: Seaview Lodge is a friendly lodge by the sea in Indreabhán, on the Connemara coast road west of Spiddal.

Guests love the hosts, who take time to chat and give good travel advice. It’s handy for the Aran Islands ferry from Ros a’ Mhíl, the beach is close by for a swim, and there’s bicycle parking for cyclists on the Wild Atlantic Way.
ga: Is lóistín cairdiúil cois farraige é Seaview Lodge in Indreabhán, ar bhóthar an chósta i gConamara siar ón Spidéal.

Is breá le haíonna na hóstaigh, a chaitheann am ag comhrá agus a thugann comhairle mhaith taistil. Tá sé áisiúil do bhád Árann ó Ros a’ Mhíl, tá an trá in aice láimhe le haghaidh snámh, agus tá páirceáil rothar ann do rothaithe ar Shlí an Atlantaigh Fhiáin.

desc.en: Good-value beds in a shared room: ideal for cyclists and walkers.
desc.ga: Leapacha ar luach maith i seomra comhroinnte: iontach do rothaithe agus do shiúlóirí.

desc.en: Book the beds you need for your group, directly with us.
desc.ga: Cuir in áirithe na leapacha a theastaíonn do do ghrúpa, go díreach linn.

policies.en: Check-in 3pm–9pm. Stays of up to 7 nights.
policies.ga: Teacht isteach 3in–9in. Fanacht suas le 7 n-oíche.

policies.en: Book direct with us: no booking fees.
policies.ga: Cuir in áirithe go díreach linn: gan táillí áirithinte.

alt.ga: An cósta in aice leis an Spidéal

perks.en: Best price when you book direct
perks.ga: An praghas is fearr go díreach

perks.en: Book by phone, straight to us
perks.ga: Cuir in áirithe ar an bhfón, go díreach linn

perks.en: Ask us anything before you book
perks.ga: Cuir ceist ar bith orainn roimh ré

a.en: You deal with us, not a booking site: no booking fees, and we can answer any question before you book.
a.ga: Déileálann tú linn féin, ní le suíomh áirithinte: gan táillí áirithinte, agus is féidir linn ceist ar bith a fhreagairt sula gcuireann tú in áirithe.
